name: BLT Salad with Grilled Chicken & Avocado

cookwares.name: grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet

instructions.primary_message: Heat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet over medium heat.
Slice the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Rub both sides with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg chicken breasts, boneless skinless
3 tsp extra virgin olive oil
⅜ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place the chicken on the grill or skillet. Cook until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side.
Once chicken has been moved, add bacon to the grill or skillet. Cook until crispy, 3-4 minutes per side.
Peel and mince the garlic. In a small bowl, prepare the dressing by whisking together the minced garlic, lemon juice, mayo, olive oil, salt, and pepper. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
juice of 1 ½ lemon
3 tbsp mayonnaise
6 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
⅜ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

3 avocados
1 ½ small pkg grape tomatoes
1 ½ head romaine lettuce

instructions.primary_message: Halve and pit the avocados; slice crosswise while still in the skin and scoop out with a spoon. Halve the tomatoes. Halve the lettuce lengthwise, then chop crosswise into 2 ½ cm strips.
Slice the chicken into strips and chop or crumble the bacon.
To serve, arrange a bed of lettuce on a plate, top with tomatoes, avocado slices, chicken, and bacon. Drizzle with dressing and enjoy!
